nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Ignore-pattern configuration for the understand-anything analysis tool, excluding build artifacts, dependencies, and generated files from codebase scanning.

nodes.name: app.rc
nodes.summary: Windows resource script defining the application icon and VERSIONINFO block (company, file/product version, description) for the CoreStationHXAgent executable, sourced from version.h macros.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses preprocessor stringification macros to convert numeric version components into the FileVersion/ProductVersion string fields shown in the Windows Properties dialog.

nodes.name: app.res
nodes.summary: Compiled Windows resource binary produced from app.rc, embedding the application icon and version metadata into the final executable.

nodes.name: CoreStationHXAgent.service
nodes.summary: systemd unit file that runs the CoreStationHXAgent binary as a simple service on Linux, restarting on failure and starting at multi-user boot target.

nodes.name: changelog
nodes.summary: Debian package changelog recording version history entries for the corestationhxagent package.

nodes.name: clean
nodes.summary: Debian packaging file listing extra build artifacts to remove during the package clean step.

nodes.name: compat
nodes.summary: Specifies the debhelper compatibility level used when building the Debian package.

nodes.name: control
nodes.summary: Debian package control file declaring source/binary package metadata, maintainer, build dependencies (cmake, dh-cmake, debhelper), and runtime dependencies (network-manager, libdbus-1-3) for corestationhxagent.

nodes.name: copyright
nodes.summary: Debian copyright and licensing declaration for the corestationhxagent package and its included files.

nodes.name: dh-cmake.compat
nodes.summary: Compatibility version declaration for the dh-cmake debhelper sequence add-on used in the package build.

nodes.name: files
nodes.summary: Debhelper-generated registry of output package files produced during the Debian build process.

nodes.name: postinst
nodes.summary: Post-installation script that enables and (re)starts the CoreStationHXAgent systemd service after package install/configure, with verbose console banners for debugging.

nodes.name: postrm
nodes.summary: Post-removal script that cleans up service state (e.g., disabling/stopping CoreStationHXAgent.service) after the package is removed.

nodes.name: prerm
nodes.summary: Pre-removal script that stops the CoreStationHXAgent systemd service before the package files are removed.

nodes.name: rules
nodes.summary: Debian build rules makefile driving the package build via debhelper's dh command with CMake support, including an override to customize the auto-clean step.

nodes.name: format
nodes.summary: Declares the Debian source package format (typically 3.0 quilt) used when constructing the source package.

nodes.name: 3kcheck.cpp
nodes.summary: Windows-only CPU detection module that uses the __cpuid intrinsic to read CPU vendor/brand strings and determine whether the host is an HX2K-class CPU (Core Ultra 165H/165U/285H) versus HX3K, replacing an earlier NIC-based detection approach.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the __cpuid intrinsic directly and manual memcpy assembly of CPUID leaves to build vendor and brand strings without relying on OS APIs.

nodes.name: trim
nodes.summary: Internal helper that strips leading and trailing whitespace from a string, used to clean up raw CPUID-derived strings.

nodes.name: GetCpuInfo
nodes.summary: Reads CPU vendor and brand strings via the __cpuid intrinsic and parses out manufacturer, model, and clock speed into a CPUInfo struct.

nodes.name: IsHX2KCPU
nodes.summary: Determines whether the current (or supplied) CPU info matches one of the known HX2K CPU models, used to branch COM port selection logic (COM3 vs COM1) elsewhere in the agent.

nodes.name: Regedit.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the Regedit class's Windows Registry operations (Read, Write, Create, Delete), parsing root-key/subkey paths and using Win32 Reg* APIs with logging via the parent WindowsPlatform.

nodes.name: Read
nodes.summary: Reads a string value from a specified registry key path using RegOpenKeyExA/RegQueryValueExA, logging failures via the platform logger.

nodes.name: Write
nodes.summary: Writes a string value to a registry key, creating the full chain of intermediate subkeys with RegCreateKeyExA before setting the value with RegSetValueExA.

nodes.name: Create
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper that delegates to Write to create a registry key/value.

nodes.name: Delete
nodes.summary: Deletes a registry value under a specified key path using RegOpenKeyExA and RegDeleteValueA, with logging of the operation outcome.

nodes.name: Regedit.h
nodes.summary: Declares the Regedit class providing a small cross-cutting API (Read/Write/Create/Delete) for Windows Registry access on behalf of the parent WindowsPlatform.

nodes.name: Regedit
nodes.summary: Encapsulates Windows Registry read/write/create/delete operations, holding a back-reference to the owning WindowsPlatform for logging.

nodes.name: ServiceManager.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the ServiceManager class, providing full Windows Service Control Manager (SCM) lifecycle handling: install/uninstall, start/stop, status query and reporting, the service main and control-handler callbacks, and Win32 error formatting helpers.

nodes.name: Install
nodes.summary: Registers the executable as a Windows service with the SCM using CreateServiceW, applying the supplied ServiceConfig (start type, account, description) via ChangeServiceConfig2W.

nodes.name: Uninstall
nodes.summary: Stops a running service if necessary and removes it from the SCM via DeleteService.

nodes.name: StartService
nodes.summary: Starts an installed service via the SCM and polls QueryServiceStatus until it transitions to running or times out.

nodes.name: StopService
nodes.summary: Sends a stop control to the service via ControlService and polls until it reports SERVICE_STOPPED or times out.

nodes.name: QueryStatus
nodes.summary: Opens the service handle and retrieves its current SERVICE_STATUS via QueryServiceStatus, populating the caller's ServiceStatus struct.

nodes.name: IsInstalled
nodes.summary: Checks whether the service is registered with the SCM by attempting to open its handle.

nodes.name: IsRunning
nodes.summary: Determines whether the service is currently in the running state by delegating to QueryStatus.

nodes.name: ReportStatus
nodes.summary: Updates and reports the service's SERVICE_STATUS to the SCM via SetServiceStatus, used throughout the start/stop lifecycle.

nodes.name: RegisterServiceHandler
nodes.summary: Registers the service control handler callback with the SCM via RegisterServiceCtrlHandlerW.

nodes.name: ServiceMainProc
nodes.summary: Service entry point invoked by the SCM; reports startup status, invokes the onStart callback, and blocks on the stop event until shutdown is requested.

nodes.name: ServiceCtrlProc
nodes.summary: Control handler invoked by the SCM for service control requests (e.g., stop); reports stopping status, invokes the onStop callback, and signals the stop event.

nodes.name: OpenServiceManager
nodes.summary: Helper that opens a handle to the Service Control Manager via OpenSCManagerW, logging on failure.

nodes.name: OpenServiceHandle
nodes.summary: Helper that opens a handle to the named service via OpenServiceW with the requested access rights.

nodes.name: LogError
nodes.summary: Logs an error message combined with the formatted last Win32 error string for the given operation name.

nodes.name: GetLastErrorString
nodes.summary: Formats the current GetLastError() code into a human-readable string using FormatMessageA.

nodes.name: ServiceManager.h
nodes.summary: Declares the ServiceManager class and its nested ServiceConfig/ServiceStatus structs, exposing the full Windows Service lifecycle API (install, uninstall, start, stop, status query, SCM callbacks) used by the agent to run itself as a Windows service.

nodes.name: ServiceManager
nodes.summary: Manages the complete lifecycle of the Windows service representation of the agent, including registration with the SCM, start/stop control, status reporting, and the SCM-invoked main/control-handler callbacks.

nodes.name: SessionMonitor.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the SessionMonitor class: creates a hidden window subscribed to WTS session-change notifications (logon/logoff, lock/unlock, console/RDP connect) on a dedicated thread and reports state transitions via callback, plus a helper to query current session state including logged-in user and desktop type.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Launches the background thread that runs the hidden window message loop and WTS notification handling.

nodes.name: Stop
nodes.summary: Posts a quit message to the monitor's hidden window and joins the background thread to stop monitoring cleanly.

nodes.name: ThreadProc
nodes.summary: Background thread entry point that creates a hidden window, registers for WTS session notifications, and runs the Win32 message loop until shutdown.

nodes.name: SessionMonitor::WndProc
nodes.summary: Static window procedure that receives WM_WTSSESSION_CHANGE messages and forwards session-change events to the owning SessionMonitor instance.

nodes.name: HandleSessionChange
nodes.summary: Translates a WTS session-change notification into a human-readable description and invokes the registered callback with the resulting state string.

nodes.name: GetCurrentSessionState
nodes.summary: Determines the current session's state (locked, active, disconnected, etc.) by inspecting the active console session, the input desktop, and the logged-in user via WTS APIs.

nodes.name: SessionMonitor.h
nodes.summary: Declares the SessionMonitor class, which watches Windows Terminal Services (WTS) session-state changes via a hidden window and reports them through a callback function.

nodes.name: SessionMonitor
nodes.summary: Monitors console/RDP connect/disconnect and lock/unlock session events using a hidden message-only window and WTS notifications, invoking a callback on state changes.

nodes.name: TrayApp.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the TrayApp class: manages a Windows system tray icon showing hostname/IP/uptime, running a UI thread for the tray window and a named-pipe listener thread that parses incoming key=value updates from the agent process to refresh the displayed tooltip.

nodes.name: Trim
nodes.summary: Local helper that trims leading and trailing whitespace from a string, used when parsing named-pipe input lines.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Starts the UI thread (creating the tray window) and, once ready, starts the named-pipe listener thread.

nodes.name: Stop
nodes.summary: Signals the stop event and posts a quit message to halt both the UI and pipe threads, then joins them.

nodes.name: UpdateData
nodes.summary: Updates the stored hostname/IP/uptime strings under a mutex and posts a custom message to trigger a tooltip refresh on the UI thread.

nodes.name: ApplyTooltip
nodes.summary: Builds the tooltip text from the current hostname/IP/uptime and applies it to the tray icon via Shell_NotifyIconW.

nodes.name: TrayApp::WndProc
nodes.summary: Static window procedure for the hidden tray window, handling the custom tooltip-update message, tray icon messages, and window destruction.

nodes.name: UiThreadProc
nodes.summary: UI thread entry point that registers the window class, creates the hidden tray window, sets the initial tray icon, and runs the Win32 message loop.

nodes.name: PipeThreadProc
nodes.summary: Named-pipe listener thread that creates the CoreStation HX agent's IPC pipe, accepts connections, reads key=value formatted lines (hostname/ip/uptime), and calls UpdateData to refresh the tray tooltip in real time.

nodes.name: TrayApp.h
nodes.summary: Declares the TrayApp class, which displays a Windows system tray icon with hostname/IP/uptime information updated via UI and named-pipe listener threads.

nodes.name: TrayApp
nodes.summary: Manages a Windows system tray icon and its tooltip text, driven by a UI thread and a named-pipe listener thread that receives live host status updates.
